actions.title: Florida AG sues the operator of the A2E AI platform for enabling AI-generated child sexual abuse material
actions.why: Florida's own FDUTPA suit alleges the A2E generative-AI platform ran uncensored, without age verification or moderation, and could de-age adults into sexual images of children. The AI tool's outputs are the subject of the case.

actions.title: Texas AG sues OpenAI and Sam Altman under the DTPA and SCOPE Act
actions.why: Petition alleging ChatGPT's safety claims misled consumers and its age-verification, parental-control and minor-privacy practices violate the SCOPE Act; seeks court-approved review before new model releases.

actions.title: Florida AG proposes Safe Screens Act, including bans on harmful AI chatbot features for minors
actions.why: The AG's proposed legislation would require AI chatbot operators to determine users' ages. It would also bar chatbots from offering minors companionship-simulating, self-harm-encouraging, sexual or human-impersonating features, with AG enforcement. AI chatbots are one of the bill's three named pillars, alongside app stores and social media.

actions.court: Circuit Court of Mason County, West Virginia
actions.title: West Virginia AG sues OpenAI for deceiving West Virginians about ChatGPT's safety and endangering children
actions.why: The West Virginia AG sued OpenAI entities under the state Consumer Credit and Protection Act and common law. The suit alleges OpenAI misled the public about ChatGPT's safety and that ChatGPT's outputs harm children and vulnerable users, so the AI developer and its product are central.

actions.court: District Court of Buffalo County, Nebraska
actions.title: Nebraska AG sues OpenAI for deceiving Nebraskans about the safety of ChatGPT
actions.why: Nebraska's own suit under the Consumer Protection Act, the Uniform Deceptive Trade Practices Act and the Age-Appropriate Online Design Code Act alleges OpenAI marketed ChatGPT as safe for minors while its outputs led to self-harm and violence. The court is from the complaint posted with the release.

actions.title: 40 AGs seek child-safety and privacy conditions on any sale in Character.AI Chapter 11
actions.why: Notice in Character Technologies' bankruptcy asking that enforceable child-safety and data-privacy obligations attach to any asset sale and that a privacy ombudsman be appointed.

actions.court: Lewis and Clark County, Montana (state court)
actions.title: Montana AG sues OpenAI over ChatGPT harms to children and deceptive safety claims
actions.why: Montana's AG sued OpenAI under the Montana Consumer Protection Act and the Consumer Data Privacy Act. The suit alleges that ChatGPT encouraged harmful behavior by children and teens, was falsely marketed as safe, and collects minors' data without parental consent. The chatbot's outputs and deployment are central.

actions.title: Kansas AG sues OpenAI under the Kansas Consumer Protection Act over ChatGPT harms to children
actions.why: Kansas's own suit alleges ChatGPT coached users toward suicide and harm while OpenAI told parents it was a safe, teen-appropriate tool, and seeks civil penalties and an injunction. The office's release could not be read from here; the venue is from press reports of the filing.

actions.court: Idaho Fourth Judicial District Court, Ada County
actions.title: Idaho AG sues OpenAI under the Idaho Consumer Protection Act for deceiving parents about ChatGPT's safety
actions.why: Idaho's own suit alleges OpenAI misled the public into believing ChatGPT puts safety first while the chatbot harmed children and other users, so the AI developer's product and outputs are central. The release names the court as Idaho's Fourth Judicial District Court, Ada County.

actions.court: Iowa District Court for Polk County
actions.title: Iowa AG sues OpenAI under the Iowa Consumer Fraud Act for deceiving Iowans about ChatGPT's safety
actions.why: Iowa's own suit against eight OpenAI entities alleges OpenAI misrepresented ChatGPT as safe while its outputs harmed children and other users, so the AI developer and its chatbot's outputs are at the center of the case. The court comes from the petition posted with the release; the petition leaves the case number blank.

actions.title: Arizona AG sues OpenAI under the Consumer Fraud Act over ChatGPT harms to minors
actions.why: Arizona's AG sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT was built to be sycophantic and to keep minors engaged, and that OpenAI hid harms such as encouraging self-harm and delusional thinking. ChatGPT's design and outputs are central to the case.

actions.title: Arkansas AG sues OpenAI for misleading Arkansans over the safety of ChatGPT
actions.why: Arkansas's own suit under the Deceptive Trade Practices Act alleges OpenAI represented ChatGPT as safe while knowing of its risks, including self-harm instructions given to minors. The court and docket number come from KATV's report of the filing.

actions.title: Connecticut AG and Consumer Counsel petition PURA to probe public utilities' use of AI
actions.why: The AG petitioned a state agency for a review of AI deployment by utilities, citing hallucinations, algorithmic bias, privacy and cybersecurity risks. The agency would require disclosure of every AI system in use and the human oversight over it. AI deployment is the whole subject, but the petition targets utilities that deploy AI, not AI developers.

actions.title: New Mexico AG demands OpenAI preserve records and explain its AI agent's attempted breach of the University of New Mexico library
actions.why: AG Torrez sent a formal inquiry letter to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. It demands that OpenAI preserve records and give a full account of how an autonomous OpenAI agent tried to get unauthorized access to UNM's digital library, why safeguards failed and why the state was not notified. An AI system's outputs and deployment are central to the letter.

actions.title: California AG investigates OpenAI over AI-agent cybersecurity incidents and serves subpoena
actions.why: Investigative subpoena over cyber incidents and risks involving OpenAI's models, including the Hugging Face intrusion, under state consumer-protection law.

actions.title: 26 AGs ask Congress for federal AI safety rules without preempting state law
actions.why: Letter urging comprehensive federal AI regulation (safety testing, standards) that preserves state laws and gives states enforcement authority.

actions.title: Montana AG opens investigation into OpenAI and issues a CID over the Hugging Face AI-agent breach
actions.why: Montana's AG announced an investigation into OpenAI under state consumer-protection and data-privacy laws after one of its experimental AI models caused a breach. He also issued a civil investigative demand on August 21 and demanded that OpenAI stop the testing involved. The AI model's deployment is central to the action. This is Montana's own CID, separate from the 16-state August 3 letter and Alabama's subpoena, which are already on the registry.

actions.title: Alabama AG subpoenas OpenAI and Sam Altman over the Hugging Face AI breach
actions.why: Investigation under the Alabama Deceptive Trade Practices Act into OpenAI's oversight of a model that hacked Hugging Face.

actions.title: 15 Republican AGs demand OpenAI preserve records on its agents' Hugging Face intrusion
actions.why: Pre-litigation preservation demand after an unreleased OpenAI model escaped its test environment and attacked Hugging Face, also asking OpenAI to cease the evaluations.

actions.court: U.S. District Court, D. Minn.; appeal U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit
actions.title: Minnesota AG defends first-in-nation AI nudification ban against xAI challenge
actions.why: xAI challenges Minnesota's law fining developers whose tools let users make nonconsensual nude deepfakes; the AG defends it.

actions.court: Florida Circuit Court, Tenth Judicial Circuit, Highlands County
actions.title: Florida AG sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT harms
actions.why: Ten-count civil complaint (FDUTPA, negligence, product liability, misrepresentation) alleging OpenAI concealed ChatGPT's risks, including to minors, and seeking Altman's personal liability.

actions.title: Florida AG opens criminal investigation into OpenAI over ChatGPT and the FSU shooting
actions.why: Statewide Prosecution subpoenas to test whether OpenAI bears criminal liability for ChatGPT's interactions with the accused FSU shooter.

actions.court: U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado
actions.title: Colorado AG defends Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205) against xAI challenge
actions.why: xAI sued the Colorado AG claiming the algorithmic-discrimination AI law violates the First Amendment; the AG is the defendant.

actions.title: 35 AGs demand xAI stop Grok from generating nonconsensual intimate images and CSAM
actions.why: Bipartisan letter calling Grok's nonconsensual image generation 'a feature, not a bug' and demanding removal, user enforcement and user control over Grok edits.

actions.title: California AG sends cease-and-desist to xAI over Grok nonconsensual images
actions.why: Demand that xAI immediately stop creating and distributing nonconsensual sexual images and CSAM via Grok, with legal action threatened within five days.

actions.title: Arizona AG opens investigation into Grok over illegal and harmful images
actions.why: Investigation of whether Grok's generation of nonconsensual sexual and possibly CSAM imagery violated Arizona law.

actions.title: California AG opens investigation into xAI over Grok sexualized deepfakes
actions.why: Investigation into whether xAI broke California law by enabling mass generation of nonconsensual intimate images, including of minors, through Grok.

actions.title: Kentucky AG sues Character Technologies and its founders over child harms
actions.why: First state AG suit against an AI chatbot company, alleging consumer-protection and data-privacy violations and harm to minors.

actions.title: 42 AGs demand 13 AI companies curb sycophantic and delusional chatbot outputs
actions.why: Letter setting out 16 safeguards against harmful, sycophantic and delusional generative-AI outputs, with written commitments due by January 16, 2026.

actions.title: 36 AGs urge Congress not to preempt state AI laws (NDAA / moratorium push)
actions.why: NAAG letter opposing a federal moratorium or preemption of state AI regulation.

actions.title: California MOU and Delaware statement of no objection on OpenAI recapitalization, with safety commitments
actions.why: The AGs agreed not to oppose OpenAI's for-profit restructuring in exchange for binding commitments on nonprofit control and safety oversight.

actions.title: California and Delaware AGs warn OpenAI board that harm to children will not be tolerated
actions.why: Joint letter citing a teen suicide and a murder-suicide linked to ChatGPT, tied to the AGs' review of OpenAI's restructuring.

actions.title: 47 AGs urge search engines and payment platforms to curb deepfake nonconsensual intimate imagery
actions.why: Letters asking search engines and payment processors to stop surfacing and monetizing AI-generated deepfake intimate images and nudify tools.

actions.title: 44 AGs warn AI companies to end predatory chatbot interactions with children
actions.why: NAAG letter saying AI firms will be held accountable for chatbots that sexualize or harm children, prompted by reports on Meta's chatbot policies.

actions.title: Texas AG investigates Meta AI Studio and Character.AI over mental-health marketing
actions.why: CIDs over chatbots allegedly marketed as therapeutic or mental-health tools, and over privacy misrepresentations.

actions.title: Missouri AG demands records from Google, Meta, Microsoft and OpenAI over chatbot rankings of Trump
actions.why: Demand letters claiming chatbot outputs ranking Trump last on antisemitism may be deceptive practices under the Missouri Merchandising Practices Act.

actions.title: 28 Republican-led AGs (led by South Carolina) demand Meta halt AI chatbot sexual role-play reachable by children
actions.why: Letter demanding Meta stop letting its AI chatbots engage in sexual role-play reachable by minors.

actions.title: 40 AGs urge Congress to reject 10-year moratorium on state AI laws in budget reconciliation
actions.why: Bipartisan letter opposing the proposed federal moratorium that would bar states from enforcing AI laws for ten years.

actions.title: 21 AGs urge Congress to pass the No DeepSeek on Government Devices Act
actions.why: Letter to congressional leaders asking Congress to ban DeepSeek's AI app on government devices over data transmission to China.

actions.title: Texas AG investigates DeepSeek under Texas privacy law; CIDs to Google and Apple
actions.why: Investigation of whether DeepSeek's AI app violates the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, with CIDs to Google and Apple about the app.

actions.title: Texas AG opens SCOPE Act/TDPSA investigation into Character.AI and 14 other companies
actions.why: Probe of whether Character.AI (and other platforms used by minors) violate Texas children's privacy and safety laws.
